source_questions.q1_frame_scripts: Each base-form label's complete frame span, DoAction frames and empty-frame ranges are listed below. Clip-event script paths are separately listed; audit includes hashes, while full source is retained in scripts/fighter/rukia.json.
source_questions.q2_placeobject_vs_move: Raw SWF tag classes and placement depths/character ids are enumerated below per frame. MOVE-only records intentionally carry no new character id; clip-event paths identify event scripts from the frozen script bundle.
source_questions.q3_label_exit: Each base label is classified from the frozen sprite frame DoAction, frame-local clip-event scripts, action_exits and timeline_fallthroughs. The classification distinguishes explicit gotoAndStop()+play(), self-loop/replay, conditional enterFrame transitions, timeline fallthrough, and stop states. It does not claim event ordering or externally resumed stop states without an original-player observation; those remain runtime conditions under Q5, not inferred from label end_frame.
